plan.summary: Opening the store now removes a lock file left by a crashed process. `clear_stale_lock` was a no-op. It now deletes the lock file and ignores a missing file. Other I/O errors are returned to the caller.
plan.riskRationale: Small change in one function. It deletes a file, so the lock path and the caller's use need a check. Evidence shows no tests. The code does not check whether the lock is stale.
plan.storyArc: One change: `clear_stale_lock` goes from a stub to a real cleanup of the lock file, with clear error handling.

topics.title: Clear stale lock file when opening the store
topics.narrativeBrief: What does `clear_stale_lock` do now, and which errors does it return? Verify that `lock_path` gives the right file. Verify the caller runs this before the store opens. Check that the code cannot delete a lock held by a live process.
